uncited: *   **Input:** Scene geometry (triangles), camera parameters (view frustum), image resolution, and tiling parameters ($N, k$).
The grid is constructed by binning scene geometry into voxels.
**Pre-filtering:** Apply View Frustum Culling (VFC) and Back-Face Culling to eliminate triangles not visible to the camera.
**Grid Construction:** Sort triangles into the perspective grid voxels.
**Shared Memory Loading:** Load triangle data into shared memory.
**Front-to-Back Traversal:** Process voxels in front-to-back order.
**Optimization (Indirect Mapping):** Use indirect mapping to balance coherence and SIMD utilization.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Depends on shared memory partitioning and the number of triangles per voxel.
*   **When to Use:** Primary ray tracing on GPU hardware where shared memory reuse is critical.
